MonoBrowser 0.5.2

- Private tabs (`Ctrl+Shift+N`, menu, or command palette): in-memory session, no history, cleared when the last private tab closes
- Drag tabs to reorder them; pinned and unpinned tabs are reordered within their own group
- Import bookmarks from HTML or JSON and export them to HTML or JSON
- Tab favicons
- Site permission prompts for camera, microphone, location, notifications, and clipboard read; other requests are blocked by default
- Auto-update now checks right after startup (then every 6 hours) and shows its download progress in the Downloads window, where it can be cancelled
- Fixed a black page after switching tabs
- Only one instance runs at a time; launching again focuses the window and opens a new tab (or the given link)
- IPC calls are accepted only from MonoBrowser's own windows
- Electron updated to 44.5.1 and dependency vulnerabilities fixed
- Faster startup (V8 code cache) and lighter background timers

Downloads:
- Windows: `MonoBrowser-Setup-0.5.2.exe`
- Linux: `MonoBrowser-0.5.2-x86_64.AppImage`
